scope.action: Start the application and fetch the owner creation form.
scope.acceptance: GET /owners/new returns 200 with firstName and telephone fields.

claims.source: two original HTTP trials, compared against separate clean launches

scope.action: Submit the owner form with an empty last name and a nonnumeric telephone.
scope.acceptance: The response redisplays the form with validation errors and does not create an owner with the submitted first name.

claims.source: two original HTTP trials, compared against separate clean launches

dependsOn.reason: requires a live container and the actual owner repository
dependsOn.rule: startup enables the observation; its HTTP and database effects require their own trials

scope.action: Submit a valid owner, follow the new owner's detail link and search by last name.
scope.acceptance: A redirect identifies the saved owner. Its detail page contains the supplied name and phone number. Searching the unique last name retrieves that owner.

claims.source: two original HTTP trials, compared against separate clean launches
